skills.name: ai-code-review
skills.description: Review pull requests, branches, working-tree changes, bug fixes, refactors, and cross-repository migrations. Produce actionable findings, evidence gaps, concrete next steps, and justified acceptance recommendations; migration equivalence is an optional mode.

interface.shortDescription: 審查功能、修復、重構與移轉，列出可定位問題、修改方向及驗收證據

skills.name: define-task
skills.description: Turn vague or high-cost work into a clear task brief before execution. Use when the user wants to define a task, write a brief, clarify handoff instructions for AI or teammates, avoid rework on complex work, decide what information is missing before starting, or convert a fuzzy request into Objective, Background, Materials, Boundaries, optional Assumptions, and Definition of Done. Do not use as the primary skill for simple prompt wording, rewriting, polishing, or style optimization unless the user explicitly wants to redefine the underlying task.

interface.shortDescription: Turn fuzzy work into a clear brief
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $define-task to clarify this task before execution.

skills.name: project-setting
skills.description: Create or update project document rules, reminder hooks, and explicitly requested settings from a supplied Markdown specification. Use for document conventions, unclear categories, or delegated specification-based setup; the provider owns setting semantics.

skills.name: task-harness
skills.description: Own an explicitly enabled multi-step task through verified completion using one recoverable task contract. Use for execution, coordination, or resuming unfinished coding work across conversations. Planning alone does not authorize implementation.

interface.shortDescription: 以模型維護唯一任務合約、持續推進與驗收；hooks 不可用時主動接手檢查
interface.defaultPrompt: 使用 $task-harness 完成這項任務。先核對授權、專案設定與任務合約，診斷標準 hooks；不可用時由模型主動檢查並繼續。若需接手，先讀取原合約並核對現況，依實際證據完成必要成果。

skills.name: archify
skills.description: Create validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle/state, ERD, class, tree, timeline, and waterfall diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with dark/light themes, motion and image/SVG/WebM export. Accept requirements or Mermaid; inspect repository evidence for code-backed diagrams. Use when visualizing systems, API calls, pipelines, schemas, histories, timings, or everyday steps, parts, relationships and states. Also turn an answer into a one-page explainer, with the conclusion first, structured panels, native diagrams and charts, when the user asks for a page, an explainer or an answer to share (做成一页, 用页面讲), or proactively when the user's rules opt in with an [archify explainer: ...] line. Not for dashboards.

skills.name: define-task
skills.description: Turn vague or high-cost work into a clear task brief before execution. Use when the user wants to define a task, write a brief, clarify handoff instructions for AI or teammates, avoid rework on complex work, decide what information is missing before starting, or convert a fuzzy request into Objective, Background, Materials, Boundaries, optional Assumptions, and Definition of Done. Do not use as the primary skill for simple prompt wording, rewriting, polishing, or style optimization unless the user explicitly wants to redefine the underlying task.

interface.shortDescription: Turn fuzzy work into a clear brief
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $define-task to clarify this task before execution.

skills.name: project-setting
skills.description: Create or update a project's document placement rules and reminder hooks. Use for project document conventions or unclear document categories; manages placement, not document subject matter.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
skills.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

interface.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

hooks.command: echo project-setting: Before document operations, read project-setting.md at the project root confirmed by the user or session. Do not infer the root from tool cwd or use another project. If the root or rules are missing, unreadable, empty or conflicting, report and pause related document writes. Re-read changed rules and verify actual paths. This hook only reminds.

echo task-harness: For an explicitly enabled task read project-setting.md at the confirmed project root and the task-harness references. Restore the same task contract and verify authorization artifacts workers and unknown operations before action. If hooks are unavailable use model-led checks. This reminder does not activate a task or prove completion.

echo task-harness: Only for an explicitly enabled task re-read changed project-setting.md and reconcile the latest user instructions in the same task contract. Before dispatch or stage changes check prerequisites and model policy. After agent reports verify artifacts and evidence. Before closure check every necessary outcome and continue authorized executable work. Respect user Stop. This reminder grants no authorization and does not validate completion.

echo project-setting: Before document operations, read project-setting.md at the project root confirmed by the user or session. Do not infer the root from tool cwd or use another project. If the root or rules are missing, unreadable, empty or conflicting, report and pause related document writes. Re-read changed rules and verify actual paths. This hook only reminds.
